title: refactor(plugin-chatbot): move renderToolDetail out of ChatbotEnhanced into chat/toolDetail.tsx
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D3PqTGGb1rgoRqKj4rT4Xjk)_

Fixes #37729

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：没有。对话里的工具卡片（审批、写记录、删软件包等卡片）照常显示，只是这部分代码从对话主组件搬进了单独的文件。
- 为什么：对话界面拆分专题的第二张拆分卡；工具卡片是主组件里最大的一块，也是接下来审批卡改动要动的地方，拆开后冲突和审阅都更小。
- 出问题会怎样：只搬代码不改逻辑，最坏是某张工具卡显示异常或类型检查变红；回滚这一个合并即可。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What changes

A move-only split of `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: **1514 → 1097 lines**. The `renderToolDetail` closure (447 body lines) becomes the module-level function `renderToolDetail(tool, ctx)` in the new `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/chat/toolDetail.tsx` (580 lines), the card's preferred form.

- **The element tree is the same text.** The function body is byte-identical to the closure body after a four-space dedent (checked with `diff` of the two bodies: no difference over 447 lines). It still returns the `Tool` element at `key={tool.toolCallId}` with the same `defaultOpen` expression. The first statement destructures `ctx` into the same 41 names the closure read from the component scope, so not one reference in the body changed.
- **`ctx`.** `ChatbotEnhanced` builds one plain object, `toolDetailCtx`, where the closure used to be (no hook, no memo, so the hook order is unchanged) and calls `renderToolDetail(tool, toolDetailCtx)` where it called `renderToolDetail(tool)`. Its type, `ToolDetailContext`, is spelled from `ChatbotEnhancedProps`: a `Required` pick of the props that have defaults, a plain pick of the four that have none (`toolDecisions`, `onToolApprove`, `onOpenRecordForm`, `onOpenRecord`), plus `tt`, `L`, `toolStatusLabels`, `heldForApprovalLabel` and `detectPackageRemovedResult`.
- **Dependency direction.** `toolDetail.tsx` imports `../tool-display`, `../elements/tool`, `./toolSummary`, `./toolRecordWrite` (the card names this one) and, as types only, `./types` and `../mapMessages`. It never imports `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`.
- **`detectPackageRemovedResult` rides in `ctx`.** It is a value exported by `../mapMessages`, and shared constraint 4 allows only `import type` from that module, so the component (which already imported it) hands it in; the new module takes its type only.
- **Exports.** `renderToolDetail` and `ToolDetailContext` are exported from the new module only, because the component uses them. Nothing is added to or removed from what `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` exports, so its re-export block is unchanged and every import path still works.
- **Imports dropped from `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`**, all of them now used only inside the card: seven lucide icons, `humanizeToolName`, `unwrapToolResult`, `Tool`/`ToolHeader`/`ToolContent`/`ToolInput` (the `ToolStatusLabels` type stays, now as `import type`), `ChatbotEnhancedToolInvocation`, `SmartToolOutput`, `ToolRunningTimer`, `formatRecordWriteValue`, `writtenRecordOf`.
- **Frozen entries.** `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/index.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/core.ts` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` have an empty diff.

## Tests

One new file, the only one the card allows; no existing test file is touched.

`src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.toolCardOpenState-37729.test.tsx` renders a turn with two tool cards, one that starts closed (completed) and one that starts open (failed), flips both by clicking their headers, re-renders the component with two more messages and a fresh props object, and asserts that each card still shows what the user chose (`aria-expanded`). It was committed on the baseline first (30a37370, before the split) and run green there; it stays green after the split.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's own figure ("about 1372 → 920") was read before split A's final head. The measured figures are above: 1514 → 1097 for `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, 580 for the new module.
- What is not a moved line: comparing the multiset of removed lines with the multiset of added lines (whitespace-stripped) over the two source files, everything left over is import/export lines plus the `ctx` plumbing the card prescribes: the `ToolDetailContext` type, the `const { … } = ctx;` destructure, the `toolDetailCtx` object, the new function's signature line and the call site's added argument, and the new module's license header and module comment. Nothing inside the card's body differs.
- `--color-moved=zebra` alone does not paint the moved block, because every moved line is four spaces shallower; `git diff --color-moved=zebra --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change origin/main...HEAD` does.
- The new module exports a function and a type, not a component, so it adds no `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning. eslint over `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` reports the same one warning before and after the split.
- The branch is not merged with `main`. Since its base, `main` gained the QuestionCard work in `plugin-chatbot` (new files plus an `index.tsx` export); it touches none of this PR's files and `overlap-check` reports a clean merge.

## Verification

Read first: `chat/toolDetail.tsx`'s `ToolDetailContext` and its destructure (the only new logic-shaped text), then the `toolDetailCtx` object in `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.toolCardOpenState-37729.test.tsx` from the repository root; expect 1 file, 1 test passed.

```
git diff --color-moved=zebra --stat origin/main...HEAD
 .changeset/37729-chatbot-enhanced-split-b.md       |  10 +
 ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx | 509 ++----------------
 ...hatbotEnhanced.toolCardOpenState-37729.test.tsx |  87 ++++
 ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/chat/toolDetail.tsx | 580 +++++++++++++++++++++
 4 files changed, 723 insertions(+), 463 deletions(-)
```

The deleted lines and the added lines differ only in import/export lines, plus the `ctx` object, its type and its destructure that the card's `renderToolDetail(tool, ctx)` form requires.

<details><summary>Local readings (objectstack-ai/objectstack, head 41c8abab on merge base f926dfab; main since moved to d1139f98, which merges cleanly)</summary>

- The new test on the baseline, commit 30a37370 (before the split): `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.toolCardOpenState-37729.test.tsx`: 1 file, 1 test passed.
- The same test on 41c8abab (after the split): 1 file, 1 test passed.
- The test can fail: with the card's key changed on disk to a fresh value per render (restored from HEAD afterwards), it fails at the post-re-render assertion (`aria-expanded` "false", expected "true").
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/`: 70 files, 662 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, whose include covers the new test): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot run build`: exit 0.
- eslint over `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, `chat/toolDetail.tsx` and the new test: exit 0, 0 errors, 1 warning (`react-refresh/only-export-components` on `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`); the baseline file has the same one warning.
- dispatch-gates: all 38 derived commands ran and exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles 38 of 38, 0 NOT-MEASURED, every line with its exit code.
- `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations`: 0 new. `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: exit 0, no anchored file in the change set.
- `overlap-check`: merges cleanly with `origin/main`; no open PR shares a file.

</details>
